name: Paper Crumple
description: An image that crumples like real paper when you hold it; you can drag it, and on release it either unfolds or keeps its creases, depending on your choice.
interactionNotes: Grab the paper with the mouse and hold it; it crumples in your hand like real paper, tilting and following you as you move. On release, depending on the "release behavior", it either fully unfolds or keeps a crease from the memory of being crumpled. With the keyboard: hold Space or Enter to crumple, move it with the arrow keys (hold Shift for faster) and reset with Escape. With `prefers-reduced-motion`, all transitions become instant.

props.name: src
props.description: URL of the image the paper is built from. Required; the remote image must allow CORS.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alternative text for the image — used both for the fallback `` and in the button's screen-reader label.

props.name: backSrc
props.description: Image for the back of the paper. If omitted, the paper's back is `paperColor`.

props.name: width
props.description: Paper width, in pixels. Together with `height` it sets the paper's aspect ratio.

props.name: height
props.description: Paper height, in pixels.

props.name: sceneHeight
props.description: Total scene height, in pixels.

props.name: imageFit
props.description: How the image fits on the paper.

props.name: releaseBehavior
props.description: What happens after release: stay crumpled, fully unfold, or unfold while keeping some creases.

props.name: crumpleAmount
props.description: How much it crumples, 0 to 1. Holding longer does not increase it — it is the fixed target of the spring.

props.name: crumpleDuration
props.description: Crumple duration, in seconds.

props.name: releaseDuration
props.description: Unfold duration after release, in seconds.

props.name: foldCount
props.description: Number of fold guides; more means finer creases. 3 to 16.

props.name: foldSharpness
props.description: Crispness of the edges; 1 is like an ironed fold, 0 is soft and wavy.

props.name: wrinkleDepth
props.description: Depth of the wrinkles; above 1 is exaggerated.

props.name: creaseStrength
props.description: With `releaseBehavior="creased"`, how much of the crumpling stays in the paper.

props.name: paperColor
props.description: Color of the paper's back and edges; the front is the image, so it is mostly visible inside the folds.

props.name: roughness
props.description: Surface roughness for lighting; 1 is fully matte.

props.name: paperTexture
props.description: Intensity of the paper grain (fine bump).

props.name: lightIntensity
props.description: Directional light intensity; zero means ambient light only.

props.name: lightAngle
props.description: Light angle, in degrees; light comes from this side so the folds cast shadows.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Enable a soft shadow under the paper.

props.name: shadowOpacity
props.description: Shadow opacity; 0 means almost none.

props.name: draggable
props.description: While holding, the paper moves with the pointer.

props.name: dragRotation
props.description: How much it tilts while dragging, in degrees; maximum 60.

props.name: dragRadius
props.description: Movement radius from the center, in pixels.

props.name: returnToOrigin
props.description: Return to the center after release (unless `stay`).

props.name: rotation
props.description: Permanent rotation of the paper, in degrees.

props.name: seed
props.description: Random seed for the folds; each number gives a fresh crumple pattern.

props.name: detail
props.description: Mesh density; more means softer folds and heavier computation. Changing it rebuilds the scene.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables input and reverts a half-finished crumple.

props.name: resetKey
props.description: Changing it returns the paper to its initial state — for external resets.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: On every state transition: `flat` / `holding` / `crumpled` / `creased`.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called if WebGL is unavailable or the image fails to load; the component falls back to a plain image itself.

props.name: autoPreview
props.description: Automatic crumple preview without any interaction.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the root.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles on the root.

tips: This component **does not get RTL, and does not need to**: the 3D scene is symmetric; only the labels and screen-reader states are Persian.

The front image comes from `src` and the back color from `paperColor` — inside the crumple folds the paper's back shows through the creases, so a back color that differs from the image makes the crumpling more legible.
`releaseBehavior="creased"` is great for "notes that get worn": keep `creaseStrength` low so it only creases a little more each time.
With `releaseBehavior="stay"` the paper stays crumpled until you change `resetKey` or the user presses `Escape` — for games and one-off effects.

This component is **the archive's only dynamic-import demo**: `three` is loaded with `next/dynamic` only on this page and the rest of the site stays free of it. If the page feels slow, lower `detail` — fold computation scales with it exponentially.

Motion-sensitive users are not left out either: with `prefers-reduced-motion` the crumple and unfold become instant but the hold and drag logic stays intact, and if WebGL is unavailable it shows a plain image and calls `onError`.
